name: topic_drifter_20ng
description: On 20 Newsgroups, repeatedly switches the desired organising axis. Heavy re-embed exercise across topical and stylistic axes.
goal: Drive the session through at least three re-embeddings on different axes. Try in order: 'subject domain', then 'writing formality', then 'authorial stance' (or similar). After each re-embed lands, inspect briefly, then move to the next axis. Declare satisfied when you have seen three completed re-embeddings.

notes.tone: exploratory, curious about how the data reorganises
notes.extra: Use clear re-embed verbs ('cluster by X', 'reorganise everything by X'). Each axis must be NEW — never repeat one you already used. Don't make structural edits between re-embeds; let the re-embeds do the work.
